results.title: EU is set to propose ban on social media and AI chatbots for under-15s
results.description: The European Union will propose ​a ban restricting under-15s from social media, video-sharing platforms, AI chatbots and online games, ‌in the most sweeping plan yet to protect children from online dangers, a European Commission document seen by Reuters shows.
